name: Retro 70s
tagline: Warm cream paper with brown, orange, mustard and vermilion stripe bands, sun discs, a vinyl record and chunky Bagel Fat One headlines (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: cream paper with seventies brown, orange, mustard and vermilion on near-black brown ink

typography.style: fat rounded display type with clean sans body and tracked mono labels

best_for: Brand stories and friendly pitches that want warmth and personality: cafes, music, lifestyle and craft businesses. Works well when the speaker wants a nostalgic, human feel.
avoid_for: Dense financial or technical reporting that needs a restrained, institutional look.
